evidence.live_intermittency: Of two consecutive live `doctor` invocations (human then --json), the human run was 4/4 core green; the --json run 16 s later returned `SearXNG ReadTimeout: timed out` at the mandated 5 s timeout and exited 2. A third (allowed) --json run 3 s later was green. SearXNG intermittency is real and is the only non-determinism in the gate; a single retry is recommended before declaring a core failure. Probes were deliberately left single-attempt with the mandated 5 s hard timeout.

next_unit_hint: V0.1 can gate on `.venv/bin/resextract doctor --json` (exit 0; core 4/4). Expect docling DOWN and renderers missing pdflatex/pandoc/tectonic - both optional by design. SearXNG intermittently returns ReadTimeout at 5 s: retry once before calling a core leg down (observed twice in three runs). Do not treat the journal's sha256 hex digests as secrets (pure-hex is intentionally exempt from base64ish redaction) and note that key-name redaction uses word boundaries so `tokens_used`/`reasoning_tokens` metering survives while `token`/`api_key`/`client_secret` are redacted. Lane rows are unique on (target, slug) and dockets on (dir) to make upsert deterministic; `init_db` is idempotent and preserves rows.
schema_decisions: journal genesis entry has prev='' (empty string), not null; hash covers the entry minus the 'hash' key, canonical JSON = sort_keys + compact separators.
redaction key regex uses token boundaries: api_key|authorization|token|secret|password match only when not flanked by alphanumerics, so 'tokens_used' and 'reasoning_tokens' metering is preserved.
secret-shaped values: sk-*, okr_*, and 40+ char base64ish blobs are redacted, but pure lowercase-hex runs of 40+ chars (sha256/sha1 digests, the journal's own provenance) are exempt.
renderers leg is always ok=true and lists `missing` - absence of pdflatex/pandoc/tectonic is information, never a doctor failure.
lanes gains UNIQUE(target, slug) and dockets UNIQUE(dir) so upsert is deterministic; all other tables key on their integer id or natural PK.
store accessors take a sqlite3.Connection and return plain dicts; columns ending in '_json' accept Python objects on write and are decoded on read.
status_json() reports counts for all 11 tables, lanes by status/type, dockets by freshness, runs by status and the last run row.
